description: Label by MBID: type (Original Production, Reissue, Imprint, …), country, life span, label code (the LC number), area and areaId, IPI/ISNI identifiers, aliases, tags, ownership/imprint/distribution relationships, and external links (url-rels — Wikidata, Discogs, official site). Chain areaId into musicbrainz_browse_entities link.area. A label's releases are a potentially huge linked set (a major label can have tens of thousands), so they are NOT embedded here — enumerate them with musicbrainz_browse_entities (target_type=release, link.label).

mbid.description: Label MBID (hyphenated hexadecimal UUID; surrounding whitespace and uppercase accepted).

name: musicbrainz_get_label

items.description: An alternate name for the entity.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale of the alias. Omitted when absent.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary alias for its locale. Omitted when absent.

sortName.description: Sortable form of the alias. Omitted when absent.

type.description: Alias type (e.g. "Artist name", "Legal name"). Omitted when absent.

area.description: Associated area name. Omitted when unknown.

areaId.description: Area MBID for musicbrainz_browse_entities link.area. Omitted when unknown.

country.description: ISO country code. Omitted when unknown.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_mbid`: The MBID is malformed or the all-zeros sentinel (rejected before fetch), or MusicBrainz rejects it with HTTP 400. `entity_not_found`: The MBID is well-formed but no label exists with it (MusicBrainz returns HTTP 404). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: An external resource link (url-rel). Where cross-service IDs like Wikidata QID are surfaced.

resource.description: The external URL. Wikidata/Discogs IDs live in the URL path — chain to those servers.

ipis.description: IPI identifiers as exact strings in upstream order (may be empty).

isnis.description: ISNI identifiers as exact strings in upstream order (may be empty).

labelCode.description: Label code (LC number), without the "LC" prefix. Omitted when absent.

begin.description: Start date (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD). Omitted when unknown.

ended.description: Whether the entity has ended. Omitted when the upstream value is unknown/null.

relationships.description: Label ownership, imprint and distribution relationships in upstream order, uncapped (may be empty).

items.description: A typed relationship to another entity (band membership, performer, writer, etc.).

attributes.description: Role modifiers (e.g. "lead vocals", "assistant", "co"). Omitted when none.

begin.description: Relationship start date. Omitted when absent.

end.description: Relationship end date. Omitted when absent.

orderingKey.description: Upstream relationship sequence key, including zero. Omitted when unknown; array order is preserved.

targetDisambiguation.description: Qualifier distinguishing the related entity from namesakes. Omitted when absent.

targetId.description: MBID of the related entity — chain to the matching get_* tool. Omitted for url targets.

targetName.description: Name/title of the related entity. Omitted when absent.

sortName.description: Sortable name form. Omitted when absent.

items.description: A folksonomy tag or genre with its vote count.

count.description: Community vote count for this tag.
